name: Timers
description: With lid-timers.dll, crafting, research and facility upgrades take time again. This adds the part shop's time skip (pick a part whose timer is still running to open Uncle Death's time skip for it) and makes the facility menu show an upgrade's countdown, where the time skip is offered too. A skip costs {{cost:label}}. The timers themselves need lid-timers.dll - see the readme.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Skip cost

options.label: 1 Death Metal per unit (as in the online game)

settings.help: What Uncle Death's time skip costs. The units depend on the time left (master_waiting_reduce): 1 for up to an hour, then 1 more per 5 hours up to a day, then 1 more per 10 hours. Death Metals need the Death Metals mod; without it, pick Kill Coins. One Death Metal converts to 5,000 Kill Coins.

patches.sql:
UPDATE master_shop_product_price SET price = {{cost}}, medal = ({{cost}} = 0) WHERE id GLOB 'PRD_REDUCE_WAITING_*';
UPDATE master_text SET txt = replace(txt, '#MNEY_DM_FL', '#MNEY_KL') WHERE {{cost}} > 0 AND sct = 'TIME_CRUNCH' AND id IN ('TXT_MS', 'TXT_DONE');

patches.description: Part shop: picking a running part opens the time skip; facility menu: an upgrade shows its countdown; the time-skip screen charges {{cost:label}} (BrgGame.upk)
